title: Hosted-cluster upgrade ladder (upgrade/ladder.yaml)
description: Structure only. scripts/validate_upgrade_rules.py also enforces what a schema cannot: rungs strictly ascending, every minor between the lowest and highest rung covered, and no gate listed twice.

maxWorkerSkew.description: How many minors NodePools may lag their control plane. HyperShift allows 3; the team rule is 2.

verifiedAgainstGraph.description: YYYY-MM-DD the rungs were last checked against the upgrade graph, or null.

release.description: How a release image reference is built. cpoRepo and cpoTag come together or not at all; a mirrored layout (the default) needs them.

imagePath.description: The one full-mirror endpoint, or the public source when mirrored is false.

cpoRepo.description: The control-plane-operator image's repository. Absent: the payload's own CPO, nothing extra pinned.

mirrored.description: false when releases come straight from their public source (a connected lab): no IDMS to check. Absent means true.

adminAcks.description: Admin acks the workflow may give itself when no client called the gate's APIs in the last 24 hours; otherwise it waits for a person. A gate not listed always waits for a person.

apiUsageIgnoredUsers.description: Callers of a gated API that do not count as using it, because they walk every registered API (Red Hat KCS 6955985).

dataPlane.description: required: every NodePool rolls to this release before the control plane moves past it.

gate.description: The key in the hosted cluster's openshift-config-managed/admin-gates, as the CVO names it.

source.description: Where the API list comes from: the Red Hat article for that removal.

apis.description: APIRequestCount names, <resource>.<version>.<group>, of the APIs the gate covers.
